Resort Living In Your Own Backyard

Take a moment to unwind from the rigour of daily life and imagine the calming benefits of extending your home with a luxurious outdoor space that you can enjoy alongside family and friends, crafting memories that last a lifetime or simply escaping even momentarily from the hustle and bustle we've all come to know.

Crafting outdoor sanctuaries that improve the quality of life for our customers is our specialty and we're here to help you take backyard living to the next level. Hipel Pools brings high-end craftsmanship and personal service to every backyard transformation.

Imagine a space where prioritizing self-care and relaxation is as simple as stepping into your own backyard. For some that's entertaining family and friends and for others it's a quiet place to unwind after a long day. Our pools are customized to the outdoor living space you've been dreaming of.

Luxury Design To Custom Build!

At Hipel Pools, we believe a pool is just the beginning. We transform backyards into breathtaking retreats—designed and built with your family’s lifestyle at the heart of every detail. From the first sketch to the final stone, we listen to your vision and bring it to life with a custom pool and landscape that not only meets your needs but creates a place where unforgettable memories are made.

Request A Quote
Luxury Pool Design, Construction & Care

Your Trusted Partner For Every Step

At Hipel Pools, we believe true luxury goes beyond building a beautiful pool—it’s about creating an experience that lasts a lifetime. From the moment your vision takes shape to the day your pool is complete, and for every season that follows, we’re by your side. Our team provides expert openings, closings, maintenance, and repairs to ensure your pool remains flawless year after year. With Hipel Pools, you’re not just investing in a pool—you’re investing in a lifelong partnership built on care, trust, and enduring beauty.

Quality & Dependability You Can Count On

We’ve earned our reputation as a trusted fiberglass pool builder by being there when it matters most — delivering quality, dependability, and reliability in everything we do. Check out our most recent work of pool installations & service throughout Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph & surrounding areas.
